scope: Local independent-evaluation design for the existing iEnhancer-2L reconstruction before the separate HepG2/K562/WTC11 activity comparison. No training, predictions, website changes, commits or pushes in this stage.
question: Does the unchanged layer-I model, trained on historical 200-base chromatin labels, rank independently screened human reference fragments by VISTA e11.5 hZR reporter activity?
claim_if_executed: External transfer of a fixed reconstruction and fixed fragment-aggregation rule to this selected developmental reporter assay. Not exact published-result reproduction, a direct 200-base localization assay, universal enhancer detection, or validation of the strong/weak classifier.

prior_information.known_before_design: All historical benchmark and feature/scaling comparisons, 13 example predictions, 200 author-server comparisons, eight-case diagnostics, and archived MCSE VISTA labels/counts. Aggregate lentiMPRA QC and specificity-table membership were also inspected earlier; there is no claim of an untouched or blinded lentiMPRA dataset.

archived_vista_counts.status: historical metadata/exact-match candidates only; NOT the new final cohort

prior_information.existing_external_model_predictions: No VISTA iEnhancer-2L predictions or VISTA score/label associations exist in the inspected records. The archived MCSE plan was not executed. Record any discovery of prior scoring before proceeding.
prior_information.registration_claim: Timestamped local prespecification after the disclosed exposure; not public preregistration or third-party blinding.

primary_model.variant: original primary PseKNC, fixed 4105 features and two saved final RBF SVMs; do not select a later word/block model based on observed benchmark scores

layer2.role: preserved for later work; not evaluated against VISTA binary activity

layer2.status: frozen but not tested here; VISTA has no historical strong/weak truth labels

primary_model.external_fit_policy: No retraining, threshold tuning, feature selection, calibration, ensemble selection or model replacement. A checksum change stops the run. Future runner scores layer I only from its saved artifact.
primary_model.inference_validation: Before VISTA inference, verify stored feature conventions, dimensions, class sign, weight and source hash; replay known published iEnhancer-2L fixtures and test fragment tiling/aggregation on synthetic inputs without external labels.

candidate_source.name: Frozen local VISTA export
candidate_source.assay: hZR: Hsp68 promoter, lacZ reporter, random transgenesis; human test DNA in mouse embryos. Do not mix sZH/enSERT, other stages, alleles or species.
candidate_source.label: Use curator positive=1 and negative=0 for the entire tested fragment; negative means no reproducible positive call under this assay, not inactive everywhere. Never infer labels from absent annotations or model scores.
candidate_source.sequence_qc: Unambiguous ACGT, length >=200, same sequence as seq_hg38 in forward or reverse-complement orientation, matching inclusive hg38 coordinates and pinned BED interval. Future features use genomic-forward seq_hg38; preserve assay strand as metadata.
candidate_source.collapse: One reference fragment per vista_id; all eligible duplicate rows must agree in sequence, coordinates and label, otherwise exclude that locus as conflicting. Select lexicographically smallest exp_hier for agreeing repeats and retain all source IDs.
candidate_source.sampling: Use all eligible fragments; no score-based inclusion, class balancing or negative subsampling. Do not reuse the archived MCSE candidate manifest as a certified iEnhancer-2L cohort.
candidate_source.public_label_handling: Public VISTA labels and aggregate counts were already inspected for MCSE. Keep a new final label table separate from scoring inputs. No iEnhancer-2L score-versus-VISTA-label associations may be inspected before the sealed predictions. This is procedural separation, not blinding or a registration before all data exposure.

exclusion_universe.legacy: All 3368 original records: 2968 training and all 400 historical test records, including duplicates.
exclusion_universe.previous_model_probes: All 13 author-example windows and all 200 frozen author-server comparison queries, including the eight diagnosed differences. Quarantine all additional known prior iEnhancer-2L queries before freezing the cohort.

independence.reference_reconciliation: Verify candidate tested sequence against a pinned hg38 genome, and reconcile all legacy hg19 loci. Use complete unique hg38-to-hg19 mapping and exact reciprocal mapping with hash-pinned UCSC chains. Exclude unmappable, partial, or ambiguous candidate intervals. Resolve prior-probe loci using trusted design coordinates/reference verification or conservative complete mappings; unresolved real-genome provenance leaves this gate pending. Synthetic probes require documented non-genomic provenance. Do not compare coordinates from different assemblies directly.
independence.exact_and_similarity: Screen every contiguous 200-base substring of each full candidate fragment against every exclusion sequence in both orientations. Exclude a whole family for any exact match or unit-cost global Levenshtein distance <=40. This is not a percent-identity or CD-HIT claim. The 50-base prediction stride must never limit the exclusion screen. Accelerated screening must demonstrate guaranteed recall at the cutoff and pass exhaustive-oracle fixtures; an approximate search with unknown misses cannot certify the gate.
independence.locus_rule: Exclude entire connected candidate families for verified genomic overlap or gap <=1000 bp with any exclusion locus. Keep the same strict convention as the existing evaluation policy.
independence.families: Build transitive connected components across all metadata-eligible candidates before final exclusions using shared source locus/allele identity, overlapping or <=1000-bp-separated intervals, and any qualifying exact/near 200-base substring match in either orientation. Propagate exclusions through whole components, including links through rejected eligible fragments; never split windows, repeats or related fragments into independent observations.
independence.future_lentiMPRA_reserve: Reserve the full 60000 S10 design inserts and their connected loci/families exclusively for the later lentiMPRA study. Validate 15-base adapters at each end of each 230-base design, retain 200-base inserts, verify coordinates and screen all possible VISTA 200-base substrings against those designs using the same exact/near and <=1000-bp locus rules. Do not use activity outcomes for reservation. Missing or unverified designs/coordinates leave this gate pending.
independence.label_lineage: Trace VISTA curation and historical label sources for known reuse. Historical author selection is not fully recoverable. Separate independent experimental measurement from independence of loci and study selection; date of publication alone is not sufficient.
independence.claim_limit: Passing these declared screens supports a sequence/locus-screened external cohort under these finite rules, not proof of complete biological independence. Short motifs, remote regulation, original ascertainment and curation biases can remain.

fragment_scoring.terminal_window: Include start L-200 and deduplicate starts; no padding of shorter fragments.
fragment_scoring.orientation: Genomic-forward verified reference sequence; retain tested orientation as metadata. Never select orientation by prediction or activity.
fragment_scoring.primary: Maximum layer-I raw decision score over fixed windows, one score per experimental fragment. This is a new transfer rule, not the original paper evaluation.
fragment_scoring.secondary: Arithmetic mean of those same window scores, descriptive robustness check only.
fragment_scoring.class_prediction: max raw decision score >0 means enhancer; <=0 means non-enhancer. Unchanged zero cutoff, no optimization.
fragment_scoring.labels: Curator activity belongs to the whole fragment, never assign it as an independently measured label to each 200-base window.
fragment_scoring.length_bias: Maxima have more opportunities to be high for longer fragments. Report fragment length/window-count distributions by class, fixed length strata, and both length and GC score controls. Do not change tiling or aggregation after outcomes.

endpoints.primary: Fragment-level ROC AUC of the primary maximum layer-I score versus curator positive/negative; equal weight per retained fragment; 95% whole-component bootstrap interval.
secondary: Average precision using step-function AP, with observed positive prevalence; do not call trapezoidal PR area the same metric.
MCC, balanced accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy and confusion matrix at the unchanged >0 cutoff.
Mean-window-score ROC AUC and AP as descriptive sensitivity analyses.
Primary ROC AUC in fixed length bins 200-499, 500-999, 1000-1999, >=2000; do not merge bins after results.

Raw fragment length and genomic-forward full-fragment GC fraction as unfitted score baselines; larger value is prespecified positive, with no sign flipping. Paired AUC differences are descriptive, pointwise and uncorrected.

uncertainty.unit: whole connected component with replacement; retain every fragment and sampled multiplicity
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile; shared draws for paired contrasts
uncertainty.single_class_draws: skip and report count; require >=1900 valid draws or report interval not estimable without changing procedure
uncertainty.conditions: fixed model, selected source cohort and protocol; not training variability, source curation, original S1 selection or total design uncertainty

endpoints.precision_gate: Require >=100 distinct components containing positives and >=100 containing negatives before scoring. Report mixed-label groups, total groups and largest group. This is a pragmatic minimum, not a power guarantee; report interval width and undefined strata.
endpoints.interpretation: A primary interval wholly above 0.5 supports ranking discrimination in this assay cohort. It does not establish advantage over published accuracy, calibrated activity, tissue-specific function, or strong/weak performance. Report poor or inconclusive results without replacing the model. Stronger utility over simple controls is a separate secondary comparison.

execution_order: Verify protocol, source and existing model hashes; this stage ends here with pending cohort gates.
Complete reference, exact/near, family, previous-probe and future-library reserve screens; save exclusions and reasons for every source fragment.
Freeze cohort IDs, groups, labels in a separate file, source/chain/reference hashes, runner/environment and all scoring rules. Check precision gate before predictions.
Use synthetic tests and known replay fixtures to validate a separate layer-I fragment runner.
Predict windows and aggregate one score per fragment without access to assay labels. Seal window predictions, fragment predictions and hashes.
Join sealed predictions to labels once and report every specified endpoint, exclusions and limitations.
Amendments after unsealing create a new exploratory version; do not overwrite this protocol or label a reused cohort untouched.

later_three_cell_handoff.source: Agarwal, Inoue et al. 2025, Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08430-9; the same designed DNA library was tested in HepG2, K562 and WTC11.
required_before_comparison: Separate lentiMPRA protocol and final source/model/measurement hashes before model-score/activity joins.
Verify adapters, IDs, hg19 references, assembly conventions, all assay file lineages, normalization, replicate aggregation and barcode/coverage rules; resolve original FASTA/control-name issues.
Exclude families touching all legacy records, all 13 example windows, all 200 previous server probes, and the completed VISTA evaluation; preserve the reserve from this protocol.

Use a prespecified common measurement cohort and related-sequence groups. Do not choose cells or records by model performance. Combined and replicate ENCODE files represent overlapping measurements and must not be concatenated as independent observations.

Define layer-I score versus measured activity as the primary association question in each cell. Specify exact target scale, Spearman endpoints, whole-family uncertainty and multiplicity across three cells before joins. Layer-II analyses are secondary and cannot relabel historical strong/weak categories as experimental high/low activity.
later_three_cell_handoff.status: handoff requirements only; experimental processing and exact later endpoint protocol remain unresolved
later_three_cell_handoff.interpretation_of_vista_result: A poor VISTA result remains reportable and does not prove the model cannot relate to lentiMPRA in another context. Do not tune on VISTA and then claim unchanged-model confirmation. Any changed model needs a new evaluation protocol and fresh confirmation cohort.
